newsitem.title: USA: Jacor expects $216 mln from offerings.
newsitem.headline: Jacor expects $216 mln from offerings.

text.p: Jacor Communications Inc said Friday it expects to raise net proceeds of about $216 million from two equity offerings totalling 7.32 million shares.
The radio broadcast holding company said it offered 6.65 million shares to the public at $31 a share through an underwriting group led by Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp.
In a separate offering, affiliates of Equity Group Investments committed to buy 673,000 shares for $20 million, it said.
Equity Group, an affiliate of its largest shareholder, Zell/Chilmark Fund LP, is a privately-owned investment firm headed by Jacor chairman Samuel Zell, it said.
It said the closing of the offering to Equity Group is contingent upon the closing of the underwrtten offering. The underwriters have an option to buy up to an additional 997,500 shares
Closings are expected to take place on May 21, it said.
